column2: Subject  to  the  provision  of  this  Act,  and  any  other

column1: written law, the Corporation shall have the power—

column2: to purchase, acquire, rent, construct and otherwise
obtain lands  or buildings which may be required
for the purpose of the Corporation;
to  borrow  or  raise  money  from  the  Government
approved Banks and other institutions or accept aids
and donations (foreign and local) for the purposes
of the Corporation with the approval of the Council;
to make, draw, accept, discount, endorse, negotiate,
buy,  sell  and  issue  bills  of  exchange,  cheques,
promissory  notes  and  other  negotiable  instrument
and  to  open,  operate,  maintain  and  close  bank
